caseName: Caspari, Superintendent, Missouri Eastern Correctional Center v. Bohlen
caseNameFull: Caspari, Superintendent, Missouri Eastern Correctional Center, Et Al. v. Bohlen

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 508 U. S. 971.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Richard H. Sindel, Esq., of Clayton, Mo., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
